intro:
You collect the parameters of an integration from several sources that disagree. A fixed precedence rule decides.

Initial specification:
- [e001] Precedence rule: when sources disagree, the order of authority is erratum > spec > vendor-sheet > wiki > email. Inside one source, the higher version wins.
- [e002] The spec document SPEC-1 (version 1) states that the password hash algorithm is `argon2id`.
- [e003] According to spec SPEC-1 version 1, the data residency region is `us-zone`.
- [e004] According to spec SPEC-1 version 1, the maximum payload size in KB is `512`.
- [e005] According to spec SPEC-1 version 1, the export file format is `csv`.
- [e006] The spec document SPEC-1 (version 1) states that the strict validation mode is `ON`.
- [e007] The vendor-sheet document VS-128 (version 2) states that the data retention in days is `90`.

Sources, from highest to lowest authority: erratum, spec, vendor-sheet, wiki, email. When two sources disagree, the higher one decides.
Inside one source, a higher version number overrides a lower one. A withdrawn document no longer counts at all.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
